text:
Alexa: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands — asked to share concrete timelines for the API, Console, and Optimize items we demoed. Can leadership confirm target quarters and any blockers? Thanks!

Tom: Short answers to start: API v2 (streaming + rate-limit improvements) -> GA target end of May (Q2). Console rollout (new route/dashboard + rollout controls) -> canary mid-June, GA late Q3. Optimize (auto-batching suggestions + quantization advisor) -> beta to select customers in July, GA Q4. High-level only, details below. :spiral_calendar:

Maria: tiny clarifying note — Console canary depends on rollout infra (traffic routing + flags), that's still on infra backlog.

Sanjay: +1. Infra needs KV cache tweaks and canary routing plumbing; we're aiming to finish infra work by 2024-06-10. Biggest risk is the open infra headcount spot — could slip ~2 weeks. :warning:

Jess: DevEx / SDKs will ship matching changes: streaming SDK + Optimize client. Docs + migration guide will be available with each beta. We'll sync deadlines with PMs.

Amanda: From comms/ops side — need explicit dates to schedule pre-announce banners and support docs. UX copy & in-console banner require ~2 weeks lead.

Tom: Actionable comms plan (draft): 6/01 - API pre-announce blog + changelog; 6/08 - Console canary invite to partners; 7/01 - Optimize beta invite. We'll post a public roadmap update by EOD Friday.

Chris: @Sanjay if infra slips, what's our fallback? Can we run a single-region canary?

Sanjay: Yes — fallback is single-region canary (us-west1). It reduces sample size ~50% but safe for initial validation. Also can configure lower qps for participants.

Maria: Canary config example for rollout policy (example):
```yaml
canary:
  percent: 5
  duration_days: 7
```
Optimize beta note: we'll gate on customers <=50 RPS to reduce noisy metrics.

Alexa: Thanks — this helps. Please add any unresolved blockers to the all-hands follow-up doc or drop them in #product. We'll track action items there. :thumbsup:

All-Hands Bot: Recording + Q&A doc uploaded -> https://meetings.redwood.ai/rec/1711304800. Slides + follow-up checklist also attached in the confluence page: https://confluence.redwood.ai/all-hands-2024-roadmap

Tom: I'll follow up with a one-pager and dates tomorrow. If anyone has hard objections to the timing, flag them here or DM me.

Jess: Will prepare the SDK changelog draft by next Tue.

Sanjay: I'll post infra runbook for canary fallback by EOD Friday.

Maria: Adding migration checklist to the repo: https://git.redwood.ai/roadmap/migration-checklists (will ping when ready).

Alexa: Great — thanks everyone.
